clips.title: The story
paras: Brewmeister Bilger is an intoxicated dwarven brewer residing in the cellar of the inn at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He whiles away his hours tasting potent spirits and waiting on deliveries from distant lands.
Bilger spends his days pacing the cool cellar beneath Southshore's inn, nursing hiccups and seeking out the strongest brews Azeroth can offer.

Despite his perpetual stupor, Bilger remains a discerning judge of spirits. He maintains an appetite for heavy dwarven moonshines and potent liquors crafted in the south, eagerly receiving special batches like the moonshine Foggy MacKreel sends him from the Thandol Span.
